svg.title: Keras Sequential Neural Network Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Detailed architecture diagram of a Keras Sequential model with Dense layers: Input (784), Hidden Layer 1 (128, ReLU), Hidden Layer 2 (64, ReLU), Output Layer (10, Softmax), with training configuration.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the input shape (784,) mean in a Keras Dense layer?')
sendPrompt('How does Dense(128, activation=relu) work in Keras?')
sendPrompt('Why add a second hidden Dense layer with 64 units?')
sendPrompt('What does the softmax activation in the output layer do?')
g.text: output: σ(zᵢ) = eᶻⁱ / Σeᶻʲ → shape (10,) Σ = 1.0

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does sparse_categorical_crossentropy loss do and when should I use it?')
g.text: Loss = −log(p_true) Adam: adaptive lr per weight, momentum + RMSProp

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens during each training epoch in model.fit?')
g.text: each epoch: forward pass → loss → backprop → Adam update
gradients flow back through layers via chain rule
10 passes over the full training set

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I count total trainable parameters in a Keras model?')
